text:
deploy-bot: Starting deploy to prod-eu2 — tag=v2.9.0-rc3 commit=0f4a9c
deploy-bot: Canary plan: 50% -> 100% if metrics stable. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Monitoring hooks enabled :eyes:

jen: Heads-up — this rollout includes the new quantized kernel. Watch 95/99p latency and OOMs.

mike: noted, i'll watch the dashboards and logs.

deploy-bot: Canary finished (50% traffic). Metrics snapshot: p95=120ms, p99=420ms, 5xx=0.10%

sam: seeing a spike in 5xx from runtime starting ~1768012400, current aggregate ~0.8% and rising :rotating_light:

sre-oncall: Can we pause the canary? Sam, what's the failure mode? is it model swap related?

sam: stack traces show repeated OOM/retry on worker-7 with kv-cache churn, logs: `runtime: kv cache miss -> OOM -> retry loop`

carla: If a worker kernel is OOM'ing, prefer drain + revert. Safer than letting it burn through more nodes.

jen: agree. recommendation: rollback to last stable tag v2.8.1 and pin until kernel fix.

sam: initiating rollback now. command: `deployctl rollback --env prod-eu2 --target-tag v2.8.1 --reason "OOM spike in canary"` :rotating_light:

mike: switching traffic gracefully, watching autoscaler and drain signals.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by sam — env=prod-eu2 target=v2.8.1 commit=3a7b2f
Step 1/4: disable canary traffic -> success
Step 2/4: drain worker-7 and related pods -> success
Step 3/4: deploy tag v2.8.1 to replicas -> success
Step 4/4: re-enable traffic with gradual ramp -> in progress

deploy-bot: Revert deploy completed :white_check_mark: env=prod-eu2 rolled back to tag=v2.8.1 commit=3a7b2f
Notes: graceful swap, no customer-facing downtime detected. Pinned release= v2.8.1 in production.
Incident: INC-2026-045 created for follow-up.

sre-oncall: Confirming post-rollback metrics. 5xx has dropped back to baseline (~0.06%). :thumbsup:

carla: opening postmortem and follow-up tasks: test matrix for quant kernel + infra mitigations. assigning to sam and infra team.

sam: will collect logs, kube events, deployctl output and start the draft. attaching timestamps and stack dumps to INC-2026-045.

jen: update release notes: mark v2.9.0-rc3 as aborted due to kernel OOM, note pinned v2.8.1 until mitigation. also add rollback audit id.

deploy-bot: Rollback audit entry created: `rb-1768012345-3a7b2f`. Automatic rollforward disabled — manual override required to resume v2.9.0 rollout.

mike: thanks all. i'll keep a 2h watch on related metrics and notify if anything else trends up.
